How about a friendly sparring match now?|[[Chixia]] }} '''Moon Shooter''' is an event-exclusive [[Point of Interest|point of interest]] located in [[Taoyuan Vale]], [[Central Plains]], [[Huanglong]] during the [[By Moon's Grace]] event. ==NPCs== * [[Qingxi]] ==Descriptions== {{Description|Although the beginnings of Moon Shooter are lost to time, its simple gameplay and addictive scoring streaks have garnered high praise.
{{Color|#a5a19d|Build or Upgrade this stall to gain more Popularity. Visit the stall to experience the mini-games for rewards.}}|[[Map]] description}} Moon Shooter Location.png|Location ==Dialogue== {{Dialogue Start}} ;(First interaction) :'''Qingxi''': Happy Moon-Chasing Festival, Rover! :{{DIcon}} You too! :'''Qingxi''': Interested in the Moon Shooter? It's a traditional activity in Jinzhou. :'''Qingxi''': These past years, TD waves have kept us all on edge. Who's got time for celebrations with monsters at our doorstep? :'''Qingxi''': But this year's different. Thanks to your contributions, I get to celebrate again. :{{DIcon}} You flatter me. :{{DIcon}} I just did what needed to be done. :'''Qingxi''': Haha, such modesty. Alright, I'll let you enjoy the game. :'''Qingxi''': This shotting game should be easy for you. No battlefield pressure here, just fun. ---- :'''Qingxi:''' The fighting in Jinzhou is finally calming down, giving us a break at Rearguard Base. I finally got some time off. :'''Qingxi:''' My sister Qingning suggested we make the most of it and enjoy the festival in Taoyuan Vale, so here we are, joining the celebrations. :'''Qingxi:''' I've trained new soldiers for so long, I've become quite good at shooting myself. Qingning always says I'm too focused on work even during downtime. :'''Qingxi:''' I won't deny it—I take pride in the duty I carry. :'''Qingxi:''' Maybe I'll even find a few promising recruits for the Midnight Rangers. Who knows? {{Dialogue End}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Moon Shooter |zhs = 射月壶 |zht = 射月壺 |ja = 月壺打ち |ko = 달병 맞히기 |es = Tirador Lunar |fr = Tir lunaire |de = Mondschießen }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.2}} ==Navigation== {{PoI Navbox|Huanglong}}
